linework.observation: Strong rounded contours shape both people, bench, railings and shoreline.

colour.observation: Dusty navy, brown, cream and gray with restrained coastal hues.

shading.observation: Soft cel shadows on faces, clothing and wooden bench.

character_construction.observation: Protagonist has the canonical bald face; the supporting woman has a full face and brown hair.

backgrounds.observation: Coastal bench and rail beside water read as a shore location.

finish.observation: Clean illustrated forms with no obvious artifacts.

identity.observation: Bald protagonist remains recognizable; supporting character remains hair-bearing and distinct.

content.observation: Quiet letter-reading beside a family member conveys the missed connection without extra narrative props.

composition.observation: Balanced two-shot keeps both seated figures and bench within frame.

regions.people_faces: Bald protagonist reads a letter; brown-haired woman sits beside him with a concerned expression.
regions.clothing: Protagonist in navy coveralls; supporting woman in casual dark hoodie and jeans.
regions.architecture: Wooden bench, metal railing and waterfront path.
regions.distance: Water and rocks recede behind the pair.
regions.lighting: Soft overcast coastal light with natural muted tones.
